goal_freeze.top_level_goal: Build an Agent that can inspect firmware/software source code; discover plausible fault mechanisms / failure modes in the implementation; reconstruct causal mechanism and relevant execution/configuration conditions; derive corresponding detection or diagnosis rules that are operationally useful; attach source evidence and confidence/limitations so humans/downstream systems can audit them.
non_goals: making fw-context a standalone best-in-class product
exhaustively modeling every RTOS before an MVP
forbidden_goal_replacements: ship fw-context-mcp as a standalone product

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Product repo is at HEAD d8f08a4 on main, package version 0.31.0, tracked tree clean; validation campaign documented this exact HEAD as its audit baseline.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Validation campaign final verdict is NOT_READY for a full-surface real-project trial; verdict rule: any WRONG_ANSWER / SILENT_DATA_LOSS / INDEX_DIVERGENCE / CORRUPTION / STDIO_FAILURE not proven a benchmark/oracle defect forces NOT_READY.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: 58-case tally: 43 PASS, 7 FAIL_PRODUCT, 5 PARITY_CONFIRMED, 2 BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT, 1 optional NOT_RUN (V2-F3 FreeRTOS QEMU demo).

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: The 7 FAIL_PRODUCT cases: G02 (macro observability), G03 (conditional body storage), G04 (variant semantic divergence), G06 (transitive callback registration), G07 (dead-code root set on compile_commands-only projects), G10 (slot-0 data symbol), V2-C1 (CMSIS6 C-form vector table false absence).

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Verdict drivers: F-V2-001 WRONG_ANSWER/HIGH (get_vector_table returns false 'No vector table' for the standard CMSIS6 C-template form while the assembly form IS recognized — no oracle defect found for the campaign's expectation); F-V1-003 INDEX_DIVERGENCE/CRITICAL (bare-generator writes one shared compile_commands.json so last variant's defines win; compare_variants and equivalence grouping validate the collapsed data, i.e. the defect is invisible to the product's own consistency checks); F-V1-001/002/007 SILENT_DATA_LOSS/HIGH (same-source multi-define macro contexts, file-level conditional functions, single-line definitions lose data silently).
facts.source: .fw-validation/FINAL_VALIDATION_RESULTS.json verdict_drivers + FINDINGS.json findings F-V1-001, F-V1-002, F-V1-003, F-V1-007, F-V2-001

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: F-V1-003 is self-masking: group_equivalent_variants correctly groups app_entry but reports transport_send equivalent across variants A/B/C although B compiles a different branch; get_source(variant='B') served the INACTIVE uart-branch body from disk as if live with no stale warning.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: F-V1-005 (HIGH, WRONG_ANSWER): on compile_commands-only projects find_dead_code misreports the plainly live chain main->live_root->live_leaf as graph_unreachable because the root set requires a build-attested linker script; the manual backend never links and no configuration key exists to declare one. Also: find_dead_code correctly classifies the dead_a/dead_b SCC and correctly protects a KEEP-attributed symbol (linker oracle on WSL).

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: F-V1-004 (MEDIUM): direct function-pointer flows resolve; the transitive registration flow (may-target through a registration API call argument, register_cb(plus1)) does not — reachable callback set silently under-reported.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: F-V1-008 (LOW): all query surfaces cap at limit<=100 with no pagination; >100 same-name symbol rows cannot be enumerated. F-V2-002 (MEDIUM, API_CONTRACT): lookup_symbol exact=True silently relaxes to an unrelated-symbol fallback when the name is absent (marked _fallback, but violates the documented empty contract; automated existence checks get false positives). F-V4-001 (LOW, open): watcher daemon assertion during mutation; benign to CLI-written DB.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: FINAL REPAIR WAVE verdict is READY_FOR_REAL_PROJECT_TRIAL with deferred items explicitly excluded from the claim: WSL full suite 0F/3294P/192S (byte-identical proxy OFF/ON), Windows full suite 9F+1E/3109P/368S with all 10 remaining failures ledgered DEFERRED; genuinely-new failures 0 (121 ⊆ 238 machine-compared); blocking unresolved product defects 0; LEDGER_OPEN_COUNT=0.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Real product defects fixed by the repair wave: FR-NEW-1 retention deleted nothing (FK children omitted, transaction aborted mid-way, swallowed to WARNING); FR-NEW-2 local LLM-cache tier dead on Windows (invalid file://C:\ SQLite URI); FR-NEW-3 zero-TTL entries never expired (strict > boundary); FR-NEW-4 clang-capability skip; FR-NEW-5 one-spelling-per-file invariant end-to-end. FR-R1 (duplicate-USR 'corruption') was REFUTED as a product defect — reclassified TEST_EXPECTATION_WRONG under rows/3 per-context semantics, with anti-tautology verification.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Deferred items (all DEFERRED_WITH_REASON, Windows-only): FR-NEW-6 file-lock test debt (2F+1E), FR-NEW-7 six singleton contract decisions, FR-NEW-8 /shims/ path-marker (1F).

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Passing surfaces established by the campaign: large public-project indexing (Zephyr/NuttX/RIOT/FreeRTOS/CMSIS fixtures), real stdio win→win / wsl→wsl / win-launcher→wsl (cold_max 453–781 ms, warm ~15 ms, recommended timeout 5000 ms), call graph, hotspots, dead-code L1/L2 (with F-V1-005 caveat), semantic search, no-op reindex idempotence, honest empty-results on unsupported-arch queries, A1–A8 adversarial mutation classes, index integrity under repeated mutation, fanout 1→250 linear (13.2 s at 250 TUs / 2250 symbols).

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Environment shaped the evidence: Windows lacks clang/cmake/ninja/make/MSVC (G04/G11 Windows cells BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT, covered on WSL); corporate proxy forces mirror + no_proxy discipline; TLS MITM forced http.sslVerify=false for some clones (integrity anchored by recorded SHAs in PUBLIC_LOCK.json); WSL service RPC E_ACCESSDENIED was transient/restricted-sandbox (F-V0-001 RESOLVED); pip metadata staleness (F-V0-002).

facts.label: UNCERTAINTY
facts.claim: G13 (fanout scale) classification carries a V1-verifier caveat: unreliable first-pass comparison. V4 adversarial audit status is AUDIT_IN_FLIGHT with controller_result 8/8 PASS. explain_condition context resolution is nondeterministic across runs (G03 observation, resolved context A vs B in different runs).

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: Macro observability (F-V1-001): per-context macro values ARE stored in the DB (macros table, def_source=command_line) but NO supported consumer surface exposes them — lookup/search/explain/export all fail to return them; docs claim extraction; KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md has no entry. Secondary: macros.expanded_value self-inconsistent for one context (value '1', expanded_value '2').

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: F-V1-007 is the general root cause behind F-V1-002's narrower description: any single-line definition stores symbols.source='' and is invisible to search_bodies (G01/G03/G12/G13 cross-confirmed; G13 has no conditionals at all). get_source masks it via disk fallback (source_origin='disk'). One-line accessors are a very common C style.

facts.label: FACT
facts.claim: No product source code exists for the Fault Discovery Agent itself yet: the repo contains the fw-context-mcp substrate, validation harnesses, and this review pack; no fault-discovery/rule-generation pipeline code was found in the expected artifacts.

facts.label: INFERENCE
facts.claim: The validation campaign postdates the repair wave and audits a superset surface: FINAL_REPAIR_AUDIT (head e7edc34, READY_FOR_REAL_PROJECT_TRIAL with exclusions) precedes the campaign's NOT_READY at d8f08a4; the two verdicts differ in scope (trial-with-exclusions vs full-surface trial), so both can be simultaneously true — but the wording collision must be adjudicated, not ignored.
facts.source: Head chronology in FINAL_TEST_RESULTS.json (head_at_authoring e7edc34) vs FINAL_VALIDATION_RESULTS.json (head d8f08a4, generated_at_phase V5_RELEASE)
